description: Estimates electrical fundamental frequency and rotation direction from mechanical speed and pole count, with an optional low-pass filter. Single source of truth for the modulation sequencer.

inputPorts.name: Omega_Mech
inputPorts.description: Mechanical motor speed in revolutions per minute.

inputPorts.name: Poles
inputPorts.description: Motor pole count used to convert mechanical to electrical frequency.

outputPorts.name: F_Elec
outputPorts.description: Electrical fundamental frequency magnitude in hertz.

Poles.description: Fallback motor pole count when the Poles input is not wired.

Fc.description: Low-pass cutoff in hertz for the frequency estimate (0 disables filtering).
